message.content:
Based on the visual inspection of the time series plot, there is a clear shift in the mean level of the data (a step change) around index 420. The data fluctuates roughly between -2 and +2 mm before this point, and then drops to fluctuate roughly between -6 and -2 mm after this point. This entire region following the drop can be considered anomalous relative to the initial baseline behavior established in the first part of the series.

The anomaly begins abruptly at approximately x = 420 and continues until the end of the plotted data at x = 735.

Therefore, the detected range of anomalies is:
[[420, 735]]
